text: dsh-feishu-chat 是一个 DSH 网页端飞书集成插件，通过飞书机器人的长连接把聊天消息接入 DSH。收到的消息会路由到绑定工作区的会话，由子 agent 生成回复后发回原飞书聊天；用户可在设置页填写机器人凭证并切换工作区。插件还提供 feishu_send_message 工具，供 agent 向最近联系过的聊天或指定 chat_id 发送文本。需要飞书开放平台机器人应用及 App ID、App Secret；凭证保存在本机配置文件，消息和凭证会发送到 open.feishu.cn。

dsh-feishu-chat connects Feishu to DSH through a bot. Messages go to a subagent in the selected workspace, and replies return to Feishu. Configure the bot and workspace in settings. Agents can send text using feishu_send_message. A Feishu bot App ID and App Secret are required.
我想在飞书里直接和 DSH 智能体聊天，并收到它的回复。
让 agent 能把一条文本消息发到飞书聊天。
I want to route Feishu bot messages to a chosen DSH workspace and get the agent's reply in the same chat.
dsh-feishu-chat 的功能「飞书双向聊天」：插件通过飞书长连接接收消息，将文本交给绑定工作区会话的子 agent 处理，再把回复发回飞书聊天。
dsh-feishu-chat 的功能「工作区与主动发送」：在飞书设置页选择绑定工作区；agent 可调用 feishu_send_message，指定 chat_id 或发送到最近联系过的聊天。
dsh-feishu-chat 使用前须知：飞书 App ID 和 App Secret 会发送到 open.feishu.cn 获取令牌与连接地址，聊天消息也由该服务收发；凭证保存在本机配置文件。

dsh-feishu-chat README · Features：- **Connect your Feishu bot by filling in App ID / App Secret** — install the plugin, open `设置 → 飞书`, paste the two values from Feishu Open Platform → your app → 凭证与基础信息, click **保存并重新连接**, and the long connection comes up immediately. No config files to edit by hand.
- **Switch the bound workspace at any time** — the same settings page lists every workspace the profile knows about (name + path + last activity). Click any row to retarget inbound Feishu messages to that workspace; the choice persists and the router reroutes live without restarting the harness.
- **Two-way chat** — Feishu messages arrive over the official WebSocket long connection (`im.message.receive_v1`) and are delegated to a subagent of the **bound workspace's** latest session; the text reply is sent back to the same chat automatically.
- **Agent → Feishu tool** — the model gets a `feishu_send_message` tool, so any session can push a message to the last chat that contacted DSH (or a given `chat_id`).

dsh-feishu-chat README · How it works：| Piece | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host entry | `lib/index.js` | Cordis plugin (`export const name` + `export function apply`), wires config, router, WS client, tool and HTTP routes |
| Feishu API | `lib/feishu.js` | `node:https` helpers: tenant token, send message, WS endpoint |
| WS client | `lib/ws.js` | in-process long connection: protobuf `pbbp2.Frame`, auto-ack, ping, fragment merge, reconnect |
| Router | `lib/router.js` | inbound message → resolve parent agent (initiator → live agent → resume) → subagent → reply |
| Config | `lib/config.js` | `$DSH_HOME/feishu-bot/config.json` persistence |
| Routes | `lib/routes.js` | HTTP routes for the settings UI (same-origin writes only) |
| Client | `client/client.js` | `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` bundle registering the `设置 → 飞书` section |

dsh-feishu-chat README · How it works：The package is a standard DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (layer insertion) and `dsh.client` (web bundle), and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row into the profile tree.

dsh-feishu-chat README · Development / local install without a GUI restart：The profile's own patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`) is hot-reloaded:

```bash
pnpm --dir "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" add /path/to/dsh-feishu-chat
```

Then append to `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu-bot
      name: 'dsh-feishu-chat'
```

Refresh the browser — the settings section appears without restarting the harness.

dsh-feishu-chat README · Caveats：- One subagent is spawned per inbound message (no queueing); replies may arrive out of order under a burst.
- The TLS verification is relaxed (`rejectUnauthorized: false`) so the long connection works behind corporate MITM proxies / broken certificate stores; review this trade-off for your environment.
- The tool name is `feishu_send_message`; `chat_id` defaults to the most recent chat that contacted DSH.
